title: Native open tensor representatives and exact finite evaluation
statement: Fix l,E as in def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, an open immersion j:X->Z, and any recorded coherent coefficient derived system calculi SX and SZ. There exist SystemOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors and FiniteOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors n for every n, satisfying GammaEvaluation l E j SX SZ O On. All model types and GammaEvaluation are exactly those of def-coef-native-open-tensor-evaluation-data. No compactification, proper image, boundedness, finiteness or normalization of the derived inputs is required.

proof.text: Construct the native system and finite open tensor representative data by the localized-site open extension, restriction comparison, and total K-flat tensor construction.
The exact finite evaluation generator calculation identifies the evaluated system gamma with the canonical finite gamma for every pair of derived inputs.

theorem nativeOpenTensorModels_exists {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (SZ : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E Z) :
    ∃ (O : SystemOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
        SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors)
      (On : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
        SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors n),
      GammaEvaluation l E j SX SZ O On
